spans.text: Central Surveillance Room, Eastern Tower Operating Level, Avernus.
Whoosh... The electronic door opens, and a Nyto enters with a tablet under her arm. She sits down at the main terminal and starts working the controls.
...Subject No. 6 is showing rejection symptoms—increased CRP and IL-6, abnormal antibody titer.
This is the central surveillance room. Doctor Harvey, please head to Ward 6 immediately to determine if a trauma team needs to be dispatched.
...Doctor Harvey, please head...
Bam!
With her focus entirely on the terminal, the Nyto is completely oblivious to the shadow approaching from behind.
Before she can even let out a grunt, a knife slits her throat.
After dragging the corpse aside, RO635 quickly operates the controls following Koleda's instructions.
First, the monitor...
...The first step is to ensure the secrecy of their actions.
She finds Ange's room on the system, then ports another subject's monitoring data over.
Now, no matter what they do with Ange, at least they won't attract any attention right away.
Next...
RO635's fingers typing rapidly on the keyboard suddenly freeze.
On the system, she finds a directory of a large number of experiment files whose names all begin with the word "Hela".
When she tries to open them, she gets nothing but an error message.
All files pertaining to "Hela" have been deleted.
Unable to recover. They did a pretty thorough job...
But among the files is an eye-catching name.
The file that contains the name of her rescue target is intact. RO635 opens it with trembling hands.
Hela Project Subject No. 10373 – Angelia.

Vital signs under observation – The subject's vital signs are extremely unstable post-surgery. Abnormal symptoms include high fever, accelerated heart rate, and shortness of breath, indicating signs of rejection.

Laboratory tests – The subject was closely monitored after the surgery; test results showed an abnormal increase in white blood cell count and CRP levels. Liver function test also yielded abnormal readings.
Special examination – The subject underwent special rejection examination, including nerve tissue biopsy, which showed acute rejection lesions.
A line of handwritten text is found at the bottom of the file – Understood. Same-day surgery scheduled.
Signed – Laplace.
